title: 第103章：不会要拿我们当靶子吧？
slug: 流放路上捡破烂两岁萌娃养肥全家
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

苏安安并不知道，她未说完的话，让众人误会了。

她点开系统商城页面，看着只剩下三位数的积分，小脸顿时垮了下来。

枪可真贵啊，她六位数的积分，兑换了一把枪，就只剩下可怜巴巴的三位数了。

若是给大家每个人配一把枪，那得需要多少积分呀？

苏安安叹了一口气，为积分发愁。

早知道积分用得这么快，她昨天应该把那些人的衣裳和武器给回收了。

众人吃完早饭，盖房的盖房，下矿井的继续下矿井。

苏安安想让他们先熟悉手枪，黄昏时便让大家收工回去，将手枪递给他们。

手枪里没有子弹，苏安安并不担心有危险。

刘大勇霸道惯了，率先将手枪拿过来。

他拿在手上左看右看，又抠了抠扳机，稀罕得不得了。

“大勇哥，你看够了吗，可不可以给我看看？”

“催什么催？”刘大勇睨了他一眼，不舍地将手枪递给他，“小心点，可别弄坏了！”

“放心吧，我会很小心的。”

男人小心翼翼地将手枪接过来，笑得见牙不见眼。

昨晚在屏幕上看见的稀罕玩意儿，现在居然出现在了他的手里。

“看见了吗，我居然摸到它了！”

“看见了看见了，你赶紧的，我们还没看呢！”

后面的人催促着，恨不得将手枪抢过来。

但他们心里再着急，也不敢在秦昭岚和苏安安的面前造次，只能耐着性子等着。

手枪在众人之间传来传去，成了大家心中的宝贝疙瘩。

等所有人都摸了一遍，苏安安将手枪接过来，在里面装上了空包弹。

她扬起小脑袋，将上了膛的手枪，递到秦昭岚的面前。

“娘亲，你会武功，你来试试吧！”苏安安指了指扳机，“像电影里那样握着，然后抠这里哦。”

“我……我试？”

秦昭岚愣了一下，没料到安安会让她试枪。

见苏安安点头，她又看向众人，只见众人都眼巴巴地看着她。

“秦夫人，你是我们这里武功最高的人，你就帮我们打个样吧！”

“是啊是啊，我也想看看，这枪的威力，究竟像不像昨晚看见的那样厉害？”

“好，那我试试！”

秦昭岚不想让众人失望，点头答应下来。

帐篷群的帐篷多，人也多。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Su Anan didn't know that her unfinished words had been misunderstood by everyone.

She clicked on the system mall page and saw that there were only three digits of points left, and her face suddenly fell.

Guns are really expensive. After exchanging her six-digit points for a gun, she was left with a pitiful three-digit points.

If we were to equip each of us with a gun, how many points would it take?

Su Anan sighed and worried about the points.

If she had known that the points would be used up so quickly, she should have recycled those people's clothes and weapons yesterday.

After everyone finished breakfast, those who built houses built houses, and those who went down to the mines continued to go down the mines.

Su Anan wanted them to get familiar with the pistol first. At dusk, he asked everyone to call it a day and go back and hand the pistol to them.

There were no bullets in the pistol, so Su Anan was not worried about the danger.

Liu Dayong was used to being domineering and took the lead in taking the pistol.

He held it in his hand, looked left and right, and then picked the trigger. He was extremely curious.

"Brother Dayong, have you seen enough? Can you show it to me?"

"What are you urging me for?" Liu Dayong glanced at him and reluctantly handed him the pistol, "Be careful, don't break it!"

"Don't worry, I will be very careful."

The man carefully took the pistol and smiled so hard that he couldn't even see his eyes.

The rare thing he saw on the screen last night actually appeared in his hand.

"Did you see it? I actually touched it!"

"I saw it, I saw it, hurry up, we haven't seen it yet!"

The people behind urged him, eager to grab the pistol.

But no matter how anxious they were, they didn't dare to make a mistake in front of Qin Zhaolan and Su Anan. They could only wait patiently.

The pistol was passed around among the people and became a treasure in everyone's hearts.

After everyone had touched it, Su Anan took the pistol and loaded a blank bullet in it.

She raised her little head and handed the loaded pistol to Qin Zhaolan.

"Mom, you know martial arts, come and try it!" Su Anan pointed at the trigger, "Hold it like in the movie, and then dig here."

"I...I try?"

Qin Zhaolan was stunned for a moment, not expecting An An to let her test the gun.

Seeing Su Anan nodding, she looked at everyone again, only to see everyone looking at her eagerly.

"Mrs. Qin, you are the person with the highest martial arts skills here, please help us show your skills!"

"Yes, yes, I also want to see if the power of this gun is as powerful as the one I saw last night?"

"Okay, let me try!"

Qin Zhaolan didn't want to disappoint everyone, so he nodded and agreed.

There are many tents in the tent group, and there are also many people.
